source: PLACEHOLDERS: invented stand-in values, to be replaced with measured numbers

metrics.label: retrieval hit@5
metrics.how: to be measured: share of held-out course questions whose answer passage is in the top 5 retrieved chunks

metrics.label: answer sentences grounded in a cited source
metrics.how: to be measured: LLM-judge check of each sentence against the chunks it cites

metrics.label: median time to answer (p95: 3.6 s)
metrics.how: to be measured: question submitted to answer shown

metrics.label: answers with a peer verification vote
metrics.how: to be measured: the health metric: are classmates checking the AI?

metrics.label: questions per student per session
metrics.how: to be measured: across active study groups over a term
